## History

Hammond worked at a small sawmill up the river. He lived there with his wife, Mrs. Hammond, and their eight children. After living there for over two years, Hammond died, which led his wife to break up their housekeeping.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)_
